properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Alex, by email, relayed by Anthony 2026-09-17, in his words: "Perhaps a skill, like establish-taxonomy, that runs early in adopt (or after genesis), notices you are about to model repeated instances of the same category, and drives you to author the encoding once as accepted Decisions before bulk capture, so every later capture cites them instead of re-deciding ad-hoc. It's the missing bridge between genesis/adopt and 'how does this project represent its own recurring parts'. This exists as the 'master representation decision' but nothing helps you write them."

═══ WHAT THE DESIGN ALREADY HOLDS ═══
· "The taxonomy lives as Decisions" — his repos already do this by hand: accepted Decisions that say how a recurring thing is encoded (a service is a Component of kind service; a bus is an Interface with medium event; a scan is a Flow …), and later captures GOVERNED_BY them. The vocabulary exists; no skill produces it and no detector notices its absence.
· dec:idea-extraction-is-two-pass-against-an-se-schema-stated-up-front — the same idea one level up: state the schema, then extract against it.
· Component.kind, Interface.medium, Flow.flow_type, Artifact.artifact_type — the per-type vocabulary the encoding would cite.
· possible_duplicate fires on near-identical nodes; nothing fires on "the fifth Component that looks like the first four and was encoded differently".

═══ THE OPTIONS, none chosen ═══
A. ⭐ THE SKILL, three legs. (1) A served `establish-taxonomy` skill, invoked by adopt after Phase 1's breadth pass and by genesis after seeding: "list the categories this design will hold many of; for each, decide once how one instance is encoded — type, kind, which edges, what its name pattern is — as an accepted Decision, and GOVERN every instance by it." (2) An instruction in adopt/genesis pointing at it. (3) A detector that notices the trigger Alex names — several nodes of one type whose encoding differs (some with a kind, some without; some with an edge the others lack) and no Decision governing them — and asks whether an encoding decision is owed. The three-legs rule, again.
B. A DETECTOR ONLY: report inconsistent encoding among siblings and let the person write the decision. Cheaper; ⚠️ nothing then helps write it, which is the sentence he closed on.
C. A TEMPLATE: ship starter taxonomies per domain. ⚠️ dec:idea-who-warrants-a-domain-template — a template asserts what a domain is, and reflow2 has no basis for that.
D. NOTHING: his repos already do it by hand. ⚠️ Counter: "nothing helps you write them" is the report, and a discipline that works only where its author is present is the copy that drifts.

═══ THE HONEST LIMIT ═══
A taxonomy decided once is only as good as the person's category list; reflow2 can notice inconsistency among instances and can ask for the decision, and cannot know what the categories of a repository are.
properties.name: OPEN — should an `establish-taxonomy` step run early in adopt or after genesis, notice that the agent is about to model repeated instances of one category, and drive it to author the encoding ONCE as accepted Decisions so every later capture cites them instead of re-deciding ad hoc?
properties.rationale:
Captured under the brainstorm skill from a relayed field report, nothing promoted at capture. Recorded separately from the two-pass extraction idea because that one is about a CORPUS and a schema; this is about a PROJECT's own recurring parts and the moment between structure and bulk capture where the encoding is either decided or improvised — and Alex's repos have already done it by hand, which is the evidence the earlier idea lacked.

ANSWERED 2026-09-17, by promotion on Anthony's word ("I'd like to accept/promote all of Alex's ideas. We can work them after the current set of tasks."): it became req:a-taxonomy-is-decided-once-before-bulk-capture-and-every-instance-cites-it, accepted the same day, with option A (skill, instruction, detector) as its shape and cap:establish-taxonomy-before-bulk-capture planned to deliver it after the three intents accepted on 2026-09-16.
